# TALYAH PIERCE {#welcome}

Hi! I'm Talyah Pierce, and I'm a City Planning graduate student at the University of Pennsylvania. My undergraduate background is in Urban Studies and Data Science also at Penn. My coursework has focused on public policy, real estate, and statistical and spatial analysis. I’ve worked on a variety of research projects in international development and criminology while at Penn. I’ve also partnered with external organizations like the World Bank and the UN. These experiences helped me develop strong quantitative and collaborative research skills while working on real-world projects.
